Re: Douglas Humberto Urias-Orellana, et al. v. Pamela Bondi, Attorney General,
No. 24-777

Dear Ms. McNerney:
Pursuant to Supreme Court Rule 30.4, the parties respectfully request an extension of time
for the opening and response briefs in the above-captioned case.
The parties’ proposed schedule reflects our understanding that Urias-Orellana will be set
for oral argument in the December sitting.  Currently, the petitioners’ opening brief on the merits
is due on August 14, 2025, and the government’s opening brief is due on September 15, 2025.
Under the parties’ schedule, petitioners would file their opening brief on the merits by August 27,
2025; and the government would file its response brief by October 9, 2025.
An extension of time is requested to acco mmodate professional and personal obligations
during the briefing period.  Counsel for all parties have agreed to this proposed extension.
If you have any questions or would like to discuss further, please do not hesitate to call me
at (415) 395-8165.  Thank you for your kind assistance in this matter.
Respectfully,

Nicholas Rosellini
of LATHAM & WATKINS LLP
Counsel for Petitioners


cc: D. John Sauer, Counsel for Respondent
